name: kitling_unified_market_data_lake_v2
purpose: A source-preserving market-data lake for ETF and A-share research. This contract never grants broker or order capability.

storage_roles.parquet: immutable source facts and immutable research releases
storage_roles.duckdb: read-only quality, factor and backtest query engine over Parquet
storage_roles.redis: real-time transport and latest snapshots only; never a historical research authority
storage_roles.sqlite_wal: runtime orders, fills, sleeve accounting and recovery only; never a market-data research authority
storage_roles.json: release manifests, source registry, catalog pointers and evidence only

miniqmt.runtime_note: API runtime is located; historical data must still be fetched through a read-only xtdata adapter and written as source facts
miniqmt.measured_unit_scope: 2026-09-12 simulation embedded probe only: 510300.SH/600519.SH/000001.SZ volume=lots, amount=yuan by amount/close/volume≈100 check; do not generalize beyond sampled build until broader sample gate passes
miniqmt.host_import_contract: normalize_miniqmt requires measured volume_unit and amount_unit

bigqmt.history_promotion: only after source, unit, freshness and PIT gates pass

bronze_bars.rule: append-only source facts; adjusted prices must never be labelled raw

corporate_actions_v2.rule: one source fact per row; unknown numeric fields and date-only availability remain explicit and cannot enter global PIT

silver_raw_canonical_v2.rule: only VERIFIED rows are eligible for a global research release; CONFLICT and PROVISIONAL rows remain candidate-only

silver_pit_v2.rule: factor is rebuilt from canonical raw bars and validated actions; all research reads must filter available_at <= asof

universe_pit_v2.rule: current security lists must never be used to backfill a historical universe

release_policy.latest_update: requires a complete immutable candidate, directory-level atomic publish, expected-previous-release comparison, catalog lock, manifest/tree-hash roundtrip and explicit approval
release_policy.failure_behavior: CANDIDATE_ONLY or BLOCKED; preserve previous approved research release

U25_ETF_RESEARCH_PIT.scope: 25 ETF/LOF split-only conservative PIT; cash distributions are excluded from the v1.1.15 research return series and retained as an explicit limitation
